items.stem: Why did the farmer hug Buntee?
items.answer: The farmer hugged Buntee because it was missing and he was searching it for a long time.

items.stem: Do you think Buntee will leave Gajaraj and go home with the farmer?
items.answer: Buntee did not want to leave Gajaraj but the farmer was its owner so it had to leave Gajaraj and go home with him.

items.stem: Why did Gajaraj not eat his food?
items.answer: Gajaraj did not eat food because he was missing Buntee.

items.stem: Who were friends at the end of the story?
items.answer: The farmer and the mahout also became friends like Gajafaj and Buntee at the end of the story.

items.stem: Give two examples to show that Gajaraj was very happy to have a friend.
items.answer: Gajaraj was happy to have Buntee as his friend because he shared his food with it and placed it on his back.

items.stem: How did the mahout come to know that Gajaraj was sad?
items.answer: The mahout realized that Gajaraj was sad because he did not even touch the food for a couple of days and was missing his friend, Buntee.

items.stem: Why do you think Buntee licked the farmer's hand?
items.answer: Buntee licked the farmer's hand because he untied its rope and allowed it to go to meet his friend, Gajaraj.

items.stem: What was 'unlikely' about the friendship of Gajaraj and Buntee?
items.answer: The friendship of Gajaraj and Buntee was unlikely because they were very different kind of animals and had no similarities. Despite these all they became good friends.
